name: Caucus Room

steps.text: Go in by the pillar marked 333, through the double doors with the university’s logo.
The Caucus Room is on the 4th floor. After exiting the elevator, turn left.
The entrance is directly across from the bubbler.

source: Live page /operations/directions/sac-caucus, read 2026-10-19. Its pictures (the pillars, the entrance, the 4th-floor plan) were saved from the live page with the owner’s approval on 2026-10-20.
